name: analysis-loop
description: Phan tich / dac ta: chot cau hoi -> khao sat -> SRS -> SRD -> mockup
whenToUse: Yeu cau chua ro, hoac can tai lieu truoc khi code.
whenNotToUse: Yeu cau da ro va nho -> di thang sang dev-loop.

routing.note: Buoc dau la ROUTING, khong phai agent. Phan lon yeu cau khong can ca pipeline.

branches.intent: Dinh vi code ('X nam o dau')
Danh gia tac dong ('sua Y hong gi')
Yeu cau nghiep vu chua ro
Da co SRS, can thiet ke
Tranh cai ve UI/luong man hinh

steps.exitCriteria: Tra loi duoc cau hoi da chot, kem file:line
MOI yeu cau gan duoc voi mot acceptance criterion KIEM CHUNG DUOC
Bang danh doi day du (ke ca cot 'Danh doi chap nhan'); moi buoc co verifier
Da ve du 4 trang thai: rong | dang tai | loi | nhieu du lieu

stopConditions.rule: Khong chot duoc cau hoi cu the
stopConditions.action: HOI nguoi dung. Khong doc bua 200 file roi tom tat chung chung.
